what_it_does: Sales CRM with built-in calling, email and SMS for inside sales.
auth_notes: API keys sent via HTTP Basic (key as username); creating keys needs the 'Manage own API keys' role permission. OAuth 2.0 apps (client id/secret + redirect URI) for multi-user integrations.
access_notes: Any user with the role permission can create API keys in Settings; developer docs do not state plan gating. Close sells paid plans with a free trial; trial API access is inferred, not stated in docs.
api_notes: ~40 resource groups: leads, contacts, opportunities, activities, sequences, webhooks, users, groups, scheduling links, etc.
round2_change: Fully researched from official docs (was entirely unknown): API key/OAuth2, broad REST, official MCP at mcp.close.com.

what_it_does: CRM built for Google Workspace users.
auth_notes: Headers X-PW-AccessToken (API key), X-PW-Application: developer_api, X-PW-UserEmail. OAuth 2.0 section exists in developer docs for partner apps; its registration/approval process was not opened.
access_notes: Copper support states the API is available on the trial, Professional and Business plans (not on lower tiers).
api_notes: ~14 resource areas: account/users, leads, people, companies, opportunities, projects, tasks, activities, tags, custom fields, related items, files, webhooks.
round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): API-key headers, API on trial/Professional/Business, community MCP only.

what_it_does: Deal and relationship management platform for capital markets firms.
auth_notes: User generates API key in Profile after admin grants 'API' capability; key + client id exchanged at /api/rest/v1/oauth/token via client_credentials grant with scopes (data, user_management, publish, ri_import, backup).
access_notes: Only DealCloud (Intapp) customer tenants exist; admin must grant API permission. No free/trial signup found - enterprise sales-led product.
api_notes: Data and Schema APIs (generic over all configured objects/entries), User Management, Publications, Relationship Intelligence import, Site Backup; Python and C# SDKs.
human_needed: obtain a DealCloud tenant via Intapp sales/partnership and have admin grant API permission
round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): OAuth2 client-credentials with API key, official OAuth MCP, but blocked by need for an enterprise tenant.

what_it_does: Omnichannel help desk with ticketing, live chat, call center and social channels.
auth_notes: API v3 key sent in 'apikey' header; created by admin at Configuration > System > API with per-key permissions. Separate legacy v1 keys. The built-in MCP server supports OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) or a Bearer token, but the REST API is API-key only.
access_notes: 30-day free trial, no credit card. API key count is plan-limited (Starter 1, Team 5, Business 10, Enterprise unlimited). Trial API access not explicitly stated.
api_notes: API v3 (OpenAPI) per official generated Python SDK: 35+ API groups (agents, calls, contacts, companies, tickets, tags, departments, devices, grid, SLAs, subscriptions...) with roughly 200+ endpoints; legacy v1 has 12 groups/45 endpoints.
round2_change: api_breadth set to broad from the official v3 OpenAPI-generated SDK (35+ groups, ~200+ endpoints); other fields unchanged.

what_it_does: API-first customer support platform for B2B and technical teams.
auth_notes: Machine-user API key sent as 'Authorization: Bearer plainApiKey_...', created in Settings > Machine users & agents with selectable permissions; OAuth apps for acting as workspace users.
access_notes: Any workspace admin can create machine users/keys; docs state no plan gating. Plain is a paid product; self-serve signup with trial assumed, not confirmed in fetched docs.
api_notes: Single GraphQL API covering customers, threads, companies, tenants, labels, tiers, timeline, webhooks, help center; TypeScript SDK.
round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): GraphQL API with machine-user Bearer key, official OAuth-only MCP.

what_it_does: Shared inbox, help center and live chat for customer support.
auth_notes: Inbox API 2.0 uses OAuth 2.0: authorization code (third-party apps) or client credentials (own account); tokens expire after 2 days. Docs API uses a separate API key.
access_notes: API access on Standard, Plus and Pro plans (Reports endpoints need Plus/Pro); free trial available. Free plan API access not stated.
api_notes: Conversations, threads, customers (+ sub-resources), inboxes, reports, users, teams, tags, workflows, webhooks, properties; plus Docs API.
round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): OAuth2 REST API, official MCP (read-only for new connections).

what_it_does: Ecommerce-focused helpdesk for Shopify and online stores.
auth_notes: Private apps: account email as Basic username + API key (Settings > You > REST API) as password. Public apps: OAuth2; listing approval process not confirmed.
access_notes: 7-day free trial without credit card (third-party source); API credentials are per-user in Settings. Trial API access not stated by Gorgias docs.
api_notes: REST API v1.1: tickets, messages, customers, users, teams, tags, macros, rules, views, integrations, satisfaction surveys, events, etc.
round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): API key Basic / OAuth2, official MCP in open beta (May 2026, all plans); endpoint URL not confirmed.

what_it_does: People-centered customer service platform for consumer brands.
auth_notes: Token-based Basic auth: agent email as username, API token (Settings > App Developer Tools > API token, requires 'API User' role) as password. Per-org base URL https://{org}.gladly.com; sandbox at {org}.gladly.qa.
access_notes: No free trial or self-serve signup; Gladly offers only 'Book a Demo'/contact sales. Credentials exist only inside a customer org.
api_notes: ~21 REST groups: agents, answers, conversations, customers, communications, tasks, teams, inboxes, reports, export, topics, webhooks, etc.; plus Lookup API.
main_blocker: sales contact required for an account
human_needed: obtain a Gladly customer or sandbox org through sales/partnership
round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): documented Basic-auth REST API but sales-only access makes it blocked; MCP only via third-party (StackOne).

what_it_does: Community chat platform with servers, channels, voice and bots.
auth_notes: Bot token generated when adding a bot user in the Developer Portal; OAuth2 user tokens (Bearer) for acting on behalf of users and bot install via 'bot' scope. Some OAuth scopes are approved-partner only.
access_notes: Apps and bots created free in the Developer Portal. Partner-only scopes (rpc, voice, dm_channels.read etc.) need Discord approval; verified bots have no guild cap.
api_notes: REST API plus WebSocket Gateway: guilds, channels, messages, members, roles, webhooks, interactions/commands, etc.
round2_change: Auth/access now backed by official docs.discord.com pages (partner-gated scopes noted); confidence raised to high.

what_it_does: Cloud messaging app with an HTTP Bot API for bots and channels.
auth_notes: Unique token from @BotFather, embedded in URL: https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/METHOD_NAME. Separate MTProto user API exists (not used for toolkit).
access_notes: Any Telegram user can create a bot via BotFather for free.
api_notes: HTTP Bot API with ~200 methods: messages, media, chats, stickers, inline mode, payments, games, webhooks/getUpdates.
round2_change: Official core.telegram.org Bot API page now fetched as evidence; confidence raised to high.

what_it_does: Meta's Cloud API for business messaging on WhatsApp.
auth_notes: Graph API access token (temporary or System User) with whatsapp_business_messaging/management permissions plus Phone Number ID / WABA ID; Facebook Login for Business (OAuth) for tech providers and the official MCP.
access_notes: Adding WhatsApp to a Meta app creates a free test WABA and test number (up to 5 recipients). Production needs a real number and Meta Business account; messages from real numbers are billed; payment method and Business Verification are prerequisites per Meta.
api_notes: Cloud API (messages, media, templates, phone numbers, webhooks) and Business Management API on Graph API.
main_blocker: Meta business verification / app review for production
human_needed: complete Meta business verification, add payment method, pass app review for multi-tenant use
round2_change: Access now backed by official get-started page (free test number); MCP URL switched to Meta's official doc page (dev/test only).

what_it_does: Email marketing and audience management platform.
auth_notes: API key (own account) or OAuth 2 access token (third-party installs); both sent via Basic (any username, token as password) or Bearer header. Access limited by user role.
access_notes: Free Mailchimp account can generate API keys; docs say capabilities depend on plan level. Free-plan API access inferred from developer get-started guide, not explicitly stated.
api_notes: Marketing API 3.0: audiences/lists, members, campaigns, automations, templates, reports, ecommerce stores, landing pages, etc.; separate Transactional (Mandrill) API.
round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): API key/OAuth2 REST; official MCP exists only for docs search, so account-level MCP is community.

what_it_does: Email and SMS marketing automation for ecommerce brands.
auth_notes: Private key (pk_...) in 'Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key <key>' plus revision header; scoped keys need Owner/Admin/Manager role. OAuth recommended for tech partners/App Marketplace. Public site ID for client endpoints.
access_notes: Account users with Owner/Admin/Manager role create private keys; Klaviyo has a free tier. Free-tier API access not explicitly stated in fetched docs.
api_notes: JSON:API REST: profiles, lists, segments, events, metrics, campaigns, flows, templates, catalogs, coupons, reporting, webhooks, etc.
round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): private-key/OAuth REST, official remote MCP (OAuth) and local MCP (private key).

what_it_does: All-in-one funnel builder, email marketing and course platform.
auth_notes: Public API key created in Settings > MCP & API keys (max 3, optional expiry); exact header name not confirmed in fetched pages (X-API-Key per common usage). MCP uses separate MCP keys (max 90 days); OAuth planned.
access_notes: Keys are self-created in account settings; systeme.io has a free plan, but plan eligibility for the API is not stated in help articles.
api_notes: Public API covers contacts, tags, custom fields, newsletters/campaigns, funnels, courses, communities, automation rules, webhooks.
round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): self-created API key, moderate REST API, official MCP with MCP keys.

what_it_does: Visual discovery social network with pins, boards and ads.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 user access tokens are the only compliant method (Bearer on API v5).
access_notes: Apps must be approved by Pinterest before getting Trial access (sandbox-only Pins/boards, daily limits). Standard (production) access needs an upgrade request with a demo video of the OAuth flow; community reports multi-week waits.
api_notes: API v5: pins, boards, sections, user account, search, media, ads/campaigns, ad accounts, audiences, catalogs, analytics.
main_blocker: app review for Trial and Standard access
human_needed: submit app for Trial approval, then record demo video and pass Standard access review
round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): OAuth2 v5 API gated by Trial app approval and Standard review (video demo); 'admin-approval' used for Pinterest platform approval.

what_it_does: Meta's text-based social app; API for publishing and reading posts.
auth_notes: Threads OAuth: authorize at threads.com/oauth/authorize, exchange code at graph.threads.com/oauth/access_token; scopes threads_basic (required), threads_content_publish, threads_read_replies, threads_manage_replies, threads_manage_insights.
access_notes: Free Meta app with the Threads use case works for the developer and added Threads Testers; serving other users requires App Review before publishing the app (business verification may apply).
api_notes: Graph-style API: publishing (containers, carousels), replies management, deletion, location tagging, insights, profiles, publishing limits (250 posts/24h).
human_needed: pass Meta App Review for threads_* permissions
round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): Threads OAuth2 with tester-mode self-serve, App Review needed for public use, community MCP only.
